name: GiScaleLookup
description: returns the probe-GI gather render scale for which=0 Indirect,1 Reflection,2 IndirectOcn,3 ReflectionOcn: stack table 3x6 from .rdata 0x3bd4650/40/30/20 + 0x3bd41b8/0x3bd41e0, row map {0,2,1,0} at 0x3bd4610, column = g_CfgGi (GI==-1 -> column 2); HIGHEST column = 1.0 for all; patch site GI1 (caveGiScale)

name: GiRenderScalesApply
description: every frame (0x2338b0): calls GiScaleLookup(0..3) and stores the results into render params IndirectRenderScale/ReflectionRenderScale/IndirectRenderScaleForOcn/ReflectionRenderScaleForOcn via setters 0x8ccb80/0x8ccabc/0x89a9d0/0x89aa94 (last one only when sky byte [0x45b9e58]+0x500 != 0xC0)

name: SetParamIndirectRenderScale
signature: bool SetParamIndirectRenderScale(float v, void* params, int idx)
description: writes float v to render param hash 0xD8A8960F slot idx (IndirectRenderScale; sizes RefProbe#121 dispatch)

name: SetParamReflectionRenderScale
signature: bool SetParamReflectionRenderScale(float v, void* params, int idx)
description: writes float v to render param hash 0xEA3FCBD2 (ReflectionRenderScale; sizes RefProbe#414 dispatch)

name: SetParamIndirectRenderScaleForOcn
signature: bool SetParamIndirectRenderScaleForOcn(float v, void* params, int idx)
description: writes float v to render param hash 0x01FCC200 (IndirectRenderScaleForOcn, water view diffuse gather)

name: SetParamReflectionRenderScaleForOcn
signature: bool SetParamReflectionRenderScaleForOcn(float v, void* params, int idx)
description: writes float v to render param hash 0x0F38BF83 (ReflectionRenderScaleForOcn, water view reflection gather)

name: GiScaleRowMap
description: {0,2,1,0}: GiScaleLookup which -> table row (row0 Indirect/ReflOcn 0.3..0.7,1.0; row1 IndirectOcn 0.2..0.4,1.0; row2 Reflection 0.3,0.4,0.5,0.5,0.5,1.0); followed by the 16-byte float constants 0x3bd4620..0x3bd4650

name: ShadowQualityTable
description: ApplyShadowQuality rows (index clamp(SHADOW_QUAL,1,5)): +0 S+0xB98, +4/+8 sizes 512..4096, +0xC S+0xB9C/BA0, +0x10 ->0x4653b4, +0x14 ->0x8ffd28, +0x18 ->0x90df44, +0x1C..+0x30 RT hashes, +0x34 S+0xBA8, +0x38 f32 2000/2000/2000/3000/7000 (no reader found), +0x3C byte -> g_RenderGlobals+0x7598=(byte==0); HIGH vs HIGHEST differ only at +0x38/+0x3C

name: LandscapeUltraFlagTable
description: {0,0,0,0,1} by LANDSCAPE_QUALITY; read by 0x42b368: ULTRA sets terrain object +0x4A4 = 0 (else 1)

name: LandscapeLodMulTable
description: all 1.0; returned by 0x31ffc8 for LANDSCAPE_QUALITY (no effect)

name: ApplyMotionBlurQuality
description: MOTION_BLUR: S+0x188C enable, S+0x1898 samples 2/4/6/8/10 (LIGHTEST..HIGHEST); HIGHEST imm at 0x39b4da

name: TerrainApplyLandscapeFlag
description: reads g_CfgLandscapeQuality via LandscapeUltraFlagTable; sets terrain object +0x4A4

name: RenderObjSetFlagMask
signature: bool RenderObjSetFlagMask(void* obj, u32 mask, u8* changed)
description: updates per-object render flag mask (+0x1298 array, sentinel 0xFEDCBA97); adds flag 0x20 when a vtable+0x128 callback is true and g_RenderGlobals+0x7598 (set for SHADOW_QUAL <= HIGH) is set
